value.rationale: Star incidence orders form a canonical infinite family of tree-shaped height-two finite modal frames. Onto bounded morphisms encode exact modal quotients rather than routine order homomorphisms. The normal form, sharp quotient feasibility threshold, all-parameter indexed counts, and automorphism-orbit generating product give a motivated complete structural and enumerative classification for the entire family. Orbit classification adds nontrivial global quotient-moduli information beyond labeled enumeration.
